# portrait.jpg

Test picture for the face detection tests (`tests/test_faces.py`). A frontal head-and-shoulders
portrait of a US federal official.

- Commons file page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Erin_C_Conaton,_Under_Secretary_of_the_Air_Force,_official_portrait.jpg
  (page revision 1125977349)
- Original file: 2400 x 3000 JPEG, SHA-1 `6a740d9c88387daeea9d1a6eaed8d41c2aa60e1e` (the checksum
  Commons lists for the file)
- Author and source as listed on the Commons page: author "uncredited photographer", source
  http://www.af.mil/information/bios/bio.asp?bioID=13270 (official portrait of the Under Secretary of
  the Air Force, 2010, U.S. Air Force)
- Licence template on the Commons page: `{{PD-USGov-Military-Air_Force}}`, rendered as: "This image or
  file is a work of a U.S. Air Force Airman or employee, taken or made as part of that person's
  official duties. As a work of the U.S. federal government, the image or file is in the public
  domain in the United States." Commons marks the file "Public domain".
- Checked on the Commons page on 2026-11-11.
- Changes made here: resized to 720 px high (576 x 720) with ffmpeg (Lanczos, JPEG quality 4), nothing
  else.
